detect.description: How doctor detects it. Functional detection preferred over presence (e.g. hook actually fires).

install_source.description: Authoritative source URL/pointer. Never invent install commands; stored instructions are version-sensitive.

verify.description: How a fix is re-verified after install.

consequential_install.description: true => install is ASK-FIRST per D-T2-020 §2 (system-wide software, plugins, paid resources).

credentials.description: Credentials this dependency needs to actually FUNCTION. Presence of the tool is not readiness; doctor gates READY on liveness of every credential whose required_by intersects the installed capabilities (D-T2-030).

env.description: Env var names checked in order; first one set wins. Omit when the credential lives in a tool-managed store (e.g. gh keyring) - then `via` explains where.

via.description: Where the credential lives when it is not an env var (keyring, CLI login, config file).

scope.description: What the credential grants. Used to explain blast radius when it leaks or dies.

probe.description: Named liveness probe. `none` is legitimate and must carry `probe_note` - an honest UNKNOWN beats a fabricated LIVE. Built-ins: gh-auth | posthog-me | sentry-api | supabase-auth | vercel-whoami | http-get-200 | cmd-exit0 | none

probe_note.description: REQUIRED when probe is `none`: why liveness cannot be established, and what does establish it instead.

probe_url.description: For probe http-get-200. Must be a read-only endpoint.

probe_cmd.description: For probe cmd-exit0. Registry-authored ONLY - the model never invents a probe command. Must be read-only and non-mutating.

cost.description: metered/unknown probes are ASK-FIRST per D-T2-020 and are never run unattended.

mutating.description: MUST be false. A probe that writes (events, resources, rows) is not a diagnostic - it is a side effect. Doctor refuses to run mutating probes.

rotate.description: Authoritative URL/pointer for rotating or revoking this credential. Surfaced verbatim in the DEAD remediation card.

required_by.description: Capability ids. A DEAD credential blocks only if one of these is installed; otherwise it is informational.
